title: GROUNDING-AGENT-TRIAL-001: complete the v0.1 trial ledger contract + record first real run
intent: Enrich the existing Grounding Agent v0.1 trial ledger (created by PR #326, already on main) in place to complete its evidence-recording contract, and record the first genuine operational use. Adds only the missing evidence-integrity pieces: the D5 false-negative rule (requires independent evidence the claim was already wrong when Grounding ran; later drift alone does not count), the D6 human-override rule (preserve the original Grounding result, record the override separately), an Incident notes section, and the full aggregate breakdown (MATCH/PROCEED, STALE/STOP, BLOCKED/STOP, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/STOP). Records inaugural row GA-TRIAL-0001, a real STALE/STOP catch. Documentation only: no Grounding Agent code, tests, workflow, or new agent work.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Amends docs/governance/agents/GROUNDING_AGENT_v0.1_TRIAL_LEDGER.md in place: adds the D5 false-negative definition and D6 human-override semantics to the recording guidance, adds an Incident notes section, expands the aggregate summary with the per-decision breakdown, and records the first real run (GA-TRIAL-0001, STALE/STOP). Also adds an ID column and renames the time column to 'Estimated time effect' so a run identifier and non-beneficial time outcomes can be recorded. No code, schema, route, workflow, or build file is touched.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The ledger existed but was missing the evidence-integrity rules the trial depends on (false-negative independence, override-preserves-original) and the aggregate breakdown; without them the trial could silently misclassify outcomes. This completes that contract and records genuine evidence rather than duplicating the existing artifact or altering agent behavior.

commands_run: python -m tools.grounding_agent.cli --request /tmp/trial001_handoff.json --repo-root . -> STALE/STOP (exit 2): recorded as GA-TRIAL-0001
